sloka: सा त्वाम् सुप्तम् हतम् श्रुत्वा माम् च रक्षो गृहम् गताम् ।हृदयेन विदीर्णेन न भविष्यति राघव ।। ६-३२-२७।।
transliteration: sā tvām suptam hatam śrutvā mām ca rakṣo gṛham gatām ।hṛdayena vidīrṇena na bhaviṣyati rāghava ।। 6-32-27।।

translations.english: "Raghava! Hearing that you were killed while asleep and I was taken to the home of Rakshasas, Kausalya will not be able to survive with a broken heart."
